meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能从 H&E 组织切片图像(224×224 像素、约 20 倍放大)预测每个图像块内约 1.9 万个蛋白质编码基因的表达量,结果以 log1p-CPM 为单位,并按图像块位置排布。
howto.when: 当你需要从 H&E 切片图像预测空间基因表达、按基因符号(而非固定 panel)查询蛋白质编码基因,或想对整张切片(先分块)做预测时触发。需提供 224×224 像素、约 20 倍的图像块。

say.text: 先用 histolab 把整张切片分块,再预测 MKI67 的空间表达。
say.note: 会得到整张切片的表达图谱。

say.text: 分别用 evo2 和 scgpt 嵌入来源,预测同一张图的 TP53。
say.note: 可比较两种基因嵌入下的结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take an H&E histology tile (224x224 px, ~20x) and predict expression for ~19k protein-coding genes per tile in log1p-CPM, arranged on the tile grid.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need spatial gene expression from H&E tiles, want to query genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want whole-slide prediction after tiling. Tiles must be 224x224 RGB at about 20x.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D expression for this 224x224 tile with DeepSpot-M.
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values for those genes.

say_en.text: Tile the whole slide with histolab, then predict MKI67 spatially.
Run prediction on the same tile with evo2 and scgpt sources for TP53.
